idea-plugin.name: Snippeter
idea-plugin.description:
Snippeter is a fast, local-first manager for code snippets and AI prompts. This plugin brings your Snippeter library into JetBrains IDEs so you can pull a snippet into the editor at the caret, or push a selection straight back to your library — without leaving your code.

  • Sign In — authenticate with your Snippeter email and password; tokens are stored in the IDE's PasswordSafe.
  • Insert Snippet — pick a snippet (and a file, when it has more than one) and drop it at the caret.
  • Save Selection as Snippet — turn the current selection (or whole file) into a new snippet.

All actions live under Tools > Snippeter.
